$comment: What the discovery adapters (lib/technology-adapters.js) read: each snapshot is the payload one authoritative source returned, kept so that ingesting it is reproducible offline. A snapshot is evidence of discovery only — nothing in it is compatible, verified or approved until lib/technology.js evaluates it and the lifecycle moves it. Refresh with node scripts/technology.js discover <source> --fetch, which prints what changed; selection says what was kept of the payload.
